requirements_decomposition.source_phrase: Worktree-branch HEAD bridge — Chosen: option (d) — /merge auto-bulk-commits-and-merges if the worktree branch has zero commits ahead of the default branch. The auto-commit is a NEW semantic commit produced FROM the worktree's working tree at /merge invocation time. It does NOT touch refs/checkpoints/*. The auto-commit is one-per-cycle, orchestrator-blessed, and produces a clean commit message ('auto-bulk: end-of-cycle commit for <branch>' or similar).
requirements_decomposition.acceptance_criterion: AC2: from zero-ahead state, /merge runs `cd <wt> && git add -A && git commit -m 'auto-bulk: end-of-cycle commit for <branch>'` then `git merge`; git log -1 main matches `^auto-bulk: end-of-cycle commit for `; for-each-ref refs/checkpoints/ digest unchanged

requirements_decomposition.source_phrase: /spec writes into the worktree IF a worktree is active for the same spec id (detected via .claude/overnight-state-*.json or equivalent worktree-tracker file); ELSE it writes into the parent. /merge performs a stash-aware preflight: it detects untracked files in the parent at paths that the merge would touch, prints a structured report `untracked overlap detected:` followed by the file list, and exits non-zero WITHOUT calling git merge.
requirements_decomposition.acceptance_criterion: AC3+AC4: (3a) /spec from parent with active overnight writes spec to worktree, not parent. (3b) /merge with untracked overlap prints literal `untracked overlap detected:` + file list, exits non-zero, git reflog has no MERGE entry
